summary: PIMCO Asset-Based Lending Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of its limited liability company interests (Shares) under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and/or Regulation S. The company sold various classes of Shares to third-party investors for aggregate cash consideration of approximately $31.2 million, with final counts determined on August 28, 2026. It also disclosed the transactional net asset value per Share as of July 31, 2026, ranging from $10.22 to $10.30, and declared routine monthly distributions payable on September 21, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising and distribution disclosure, not a special situation.
